notes: Open-source commercial-safe oracle-layout baseline: predicted bboxes are copied verbatim from the ground-truth annotation; text is translated by Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-* per-pair models. All 16 LTB pairs covered via 13 distinct models. License: mostly Apache-2.0; en-de and en-ko use CC-BY-4.0 (TC-big). Both permit commercial use with attribution — this is the ship-able open-source MT path that NLLB-200 (CC-BY-NC-4.0) is not.
